title: Idempotency identity
spec: Implement record(events, request_id, payload). request_id and payload are strings. events is a list of (request_id, payload) tuples with unique request IDs. Append and return True only when request_id is new. Existing IDs return False without mutation even if payload differs. Different IDs may have identical payloads.
target_defect: Idempotency is keyed by payload instead of request identity.
author_rationale: The change centralizes duplicate detection before appending an event.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
